## Decisions genuinely requiring human action
- None recorded, unless supported by live evidence.

## Work history and handover
Append a dated line per meaningful verified change, linking commits, PRs, local job receipts and affected Google Drive tracker rows. Do not treat a test suggestion or planned action as executed.

## Release gate (no premature green)
- [ ] Correct commit verified in actual CI run
- [ ] Functional and security tests executed with evidence
- [ ] Production configuration checked without disclosing secrets
- [ ] Staging deployment, migration and rollback demonstrated where applicable
- [ ] Monitoring, backup and release/approval checks demonstrated
- [ ] No unresolved critical blockers
- [ ] Final approval and release revision recorded
